mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoDetail*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID /* 구매정보코드 (키) */ ,LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_SEQ /* 구매정보코드 : 화면 표기는 순번만 쓴다(상품정보코드는 옆 열에 있다) */ ,P.CMS_CATLG_ID /* 상품정보코드 */ ,C.CMS_CATEG_ID /* 상세분류코드 */ ,C.DESCRIPTION_LOC /* 품목명 */ ,C.SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ ,C.MAKER_NAME /* 제조사 */ ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE_NAME /* 원산지 */ ,C.ORDER_MEASURE /* 단위 */ ,C.MODEL_INFO /* 모델번호 */ ,DECODE(C.STATUS, 'D', 'N', 'Y') AS USE_STATUS /* 상품상태 (N=미사용) */ ,DECODE(P.STATUS, 'D', 'N', 'Y') AS SUPPLY_STATUS /* 공급상태 (N=불가) */ ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME /* 협력사명 */ ,P.AGENT AS AGENT_CODE /* 협력사코드 */ /* TO_CHAR 필수 : 이 팝업은 스크립틀릿이라 Map 값을 String 으로 캐스팅한다. NUMBER 를 그대로 내리면 BigDecimal 이 담겨 ClassCastException 이 난다(값이 NULL 인 동안은 통과한다). */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.BUY_PRICE)) AS LIST_PRICE /* 매입단가(VAT별도) */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.DELIVERY_LT)) AS LEADTIME /* 배송일수 */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.MIN_ORDER_QTY)) AS MOQ /* 최소주문수량 */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.PUR_UNIT_QTY)) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY /* 주문배수수량 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M034' AND MD.CODE = P.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE /* 거래유형 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M186' AND MD.CODE = P.DELIVERY_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_COND /* 배송유형 (팝업의 옛 '배송조건' 슬롯) */ ,P.BUY_OPEN_DATE AS PRICE_VALID_DATE /* 매입단가 시작일 */ ,P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE AS PRICE_VALID_END_DATE /* 매입단가 종료일 */ ,P.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO /* 협력사품목코드 */ ,P.TAX_TYPE AS TAX_TYPE /* 과세구분 (코드 11/12 - 팝업 select 가 코드로 고른다) */ ,P.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE /* 품목구분 (코드 ST/SI/MK/MI) */ ,(SELECT SG.SG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG CG, KEPSGMG SG WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = C.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D' AND CG.SG_ID = SG.SG_ID) AS SG_NAME ,(SELECT CG.CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG CG WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = C.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D') AS CMS_CATEG_PATH ,DECODE(C.ITEM_GUBUN, 'G', '표준품', '비표준품') AS ITEM_GUBUN_NM ,DECODE(NVL(C.ONETIME_YN,'N'), 'Y', '일회성', '일반') AS ONETIME_NM ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M181' AND MD.CODE = C.TR_HANDLE_TYPE) AS TR_HANDLE_NM ,(SELECT MD.TEXT4 FROM CMSCATEG CG, ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = C.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D' AND MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND MD.CODE2 = '1' AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = CG.SG_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(C.BASE_PRICE)) AS BASE_PRICE ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M183' AND MD.CODE = C.BASE_PRICE_TYPE) AS BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM ,NVL((SELECT 'Y' FROM CMSCATLG_HST H WHERE H.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' AND ROWNUM = 1), 'N') AS BASE_PRICE_CHG_YN ,C.ADD_DATE AS ITEM_ADD_DATE ,C.CHANGE_DATE AS ITEM_CHANGE_DATE ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = C.ADD_USER_ID) AS ITEM_ADD_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = C.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS ITEM_CHANGE_USER_NAME ,C.QUOTATION_NO AS ITEM_QUOTATION_NO ,P.ADD_DATE AS BUY_ADD_DATE ,P.CHANGE_DATE AS BUY_CHANGE_DATE ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = P.ADD_USER_ID) AS BUY_ADD_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = P.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS BUY_CHANGE_USER_NAME ,P.QUOTATION_NO AS BUY_QUOTATION_NO ,DECODE(C.SAFE_STATUS, 'CERT', '인증', 'UNCERT', '미인증', 'EXCL', '비대상', '') AS SAFE_STATUS_NM ,DECODE(C.SAFE_TYPE, 'KC', 'KC인증', 'KCS', 'KCS인증', 'KFI', 'KFI인증', C.SAFE_TYPE) AS SAFE_TYPE_NM ,C.SAFE_NO ,NVL(TRIM(C.MSDS_NO), TRIM(C.AC_NO)) AS CHEM_INFO_NO ,(SELECT A.CMC_HARMFUL_YN FROM KEPMSDSHD A WHERE A.MSDS_NO = C.MSDS_NO) AS HARMFUL_YN ,C.IMGFILE_DIR /* 상품이미지 S3 경로 */ ,C.IMGFILE_NAME /* 상품이미지 파일명 */ ,NVL2(TRIM(C.IMGFILE_DIR), 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||C.IMGFILE_DIR||'/'||C.IMGFILE_NAME, '') AS ITEM_IMAGE /* 상품이미지 URL (미등록이면 공백) */ ,C.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR /* 상세이미지 S3 경로 */ ,C.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME /* 상세이미지 파일명 */ ,NVL2(TRIM(C.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR), 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||C.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR||'/'||C.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME, '') AS DETAIL_ITEM_IMAGE /* 상세이미지 URL (미등록이면 공백) */ FROM CMSPRICE P, CMSCATLG C WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND P.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_tcode}, 1, INSTR(#{st_tcode}, '-') - 1) AND P.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_tcode}, INSTR(#{st_tcode}, '-') + 1))

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoHistoryList*/ SELECT CASE WHEN V.SORT_SEQ = 0 THEN '최초등록' WHEN V.JOB_DATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,1,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,7,2) || CASE WHEN V.ADD_TIME IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(V.ADD_TIME)) < 6 THEN '' ELSE ' '||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,3,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,5,2) END END AS CHANGE_DATE /* 변경일시 : 첫 줄은 날짜 대신 '최초등록' */ ,DECODE(V.STATUS, 'D', '불가', NULL, '', '가능') AS SUPPLY_STATUS /* 공급상태 */ ,CASE WHEN V.BUY_PRICE IS NULL OR TRIM(V.BUY_PRICE) IS NULL THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(V.BUY_PRICE), 'FM999,999,999,990.99999'), '.') END AS BUY_PRICE /* 매입단가 */ ,V.BUY_OPEN_DATE /* 매입단가 유효기간 시작일 */ ,V.BUY_CLOSE_DATE /* 매입단가 유효기간 종료일 */ ,V.DELIVERY_LT /* 배송일수 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M132' AND MD.CODE = V.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE /* 품목구분 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'TX17' AND MD.CODE = V.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE /* 과세여부 */ ,V.SELLER_ITEM_NO /* 협력사 품목코드 */ /* 변경사유 : 공급상태만 코드(M185)로 남고 나머지 항목은 텍스트로 남는다 - 코드가 없으면 텍스트를 쓴다 */ ,NVL((SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M185' AND MD.CODE = V.CHANGE_REASON_CODE) , V.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK) AS CHANGE_REASON /* 변경사유 */ ,V.ALT_CODE /* 대체코드 */ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = V.ADD_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER /* 변경담당자 */ FROM ( /* 0) 등록 시점 : 추적 8컬럼의 첫 OLD_DATA 로 되감고, 이력이 없는 컬럼은 현재값을 그대로 쓴다 */ SELECT 0 AS SORT_SEQ , P.ADD_DATE AS JOB_DATE , '000000' AS ADD_TIME , NVL(F.O_STATUS, P.STATUS) AS STATUS , NVL(F.O_BUY_PRICE, TO_CHAR(P.BUY_PRICE)) AS BUY_PRICE , NVL(F.O_BUY_OPEN, P.BUY_OPEN_DATE) AS BUY_OPEN_DATE , NVL(F.O_BUY_CLOSE, P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE , NVL(F.O_DELIVERY_LT, TO_CHAR(P.DELIVERY_LT)) AS DELIVERY_LT , NVL(F.O_ITEM_MAKE, P.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE , NVL(F.O_TAX_TYPE, P.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE , NVL(F.O_SELLER_ITEM, P.SELLER_ITEM_NO) AS SELLER_ITEM_NO , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS CHANGE_REASON_REMARK /* 대체코드는 CMSPRICE_HST 에 보관할 컬럼이 없다(대체코드 2컬럼이 설계에서 빠졌다). 이력 시점의 값을 복원할 방법이 없으므로 공란으로 둔다. */ , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS ALT_CODE , P.ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSPRICE P , (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'STATUS' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_STATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_PRICE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_BUY_PRICE , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_OPEN_DATE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_BUY_OPEN , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_CLOSE_DATE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_BUY_CLOSE , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'DELIVERY_LT' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_DELIVERY_LT , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ITEM_MAKE_TYPE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_ITEM_MAKE , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'TAX_TYPE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_TAX_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'SELLER_ITEM_NO' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS O_SELLER_ITEM FROM (SELECT JOB_COLUMN , MIN(OLD_DATA) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY JOB_DATE, ADD_TIME, JOB_SEQ) AS FIRST_OLD FROM CMSPRICE_HST WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1)) GROUP BY JOB_COLUMN)) F WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND P.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1)) UNION ALL /* 1) 변경 시점 : (JOB_DATE, ADD_TIME) 한 쌍 = 저장 한 번 = 화면 한 줄 */ SELECT 1 AS SORT_SEQ , H.JOB_DATE , H.ADD_TIME , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'STATUS' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS STATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_PRICE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS BUY_PRICE , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_OPEN_DATE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS BUY_OPEN_DATE , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BUY_CLOSE_DATE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'DELIVERY_LT' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS DELIVERY_LT , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'ITEM_MAKE_TYPE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'TAX_TYPE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS TAX_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'SELLER_ITEM_NO' THEN H.NEW_DATA END) AS SELLER_ITEM_NO , MAX(H.CHANGE_REASON_CODE) AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE /* 한 번의 저장에서 항목마다 사유가 다를 수 있다(항목별 1행) - 한 줄로 묶이니 사유도 모아 보여 준다 */ , LISTAGG(DISTINCT H.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY H.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK) AS CHANGE_REASON_REMARK , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS ALT_CODE , MAX(H.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSPRICE_HST H WHERE H.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND H.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1)) GROUP BY H.JOB_DATE, H.ADD_TIME ) V ORDER BY V.SORT_SEQ, V.JOB_DATE, V.ADD_TIME

/*updateMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoChangeItem*/ UPDATE CMSPRICE
STATUS = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'STATUS' , DECODE(#{CHG_VALUE}, 'UNAVAIL', 'D', 'C') , #{st_user_id}, #{CHG_REASON_CODE}, #{CHG_REASON}) , SUPPLY_REASON_CODE = #{CHG_REASON_CODE} , SUPPLY_REASON_REMARK = #{CHG_REASON} ,
BUY_PRICE = TO_NUMBER(F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_PRICE' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON})) ,
BUY_OPEN_DATE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_OPEN_DATE' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON}) ,
BUY_CLOSE_DATE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_CLOSE_DATE' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON}) ,
DELIVERY_LT = TO_NUMBER(F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'DELIVERY_LT' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON})) ,
ITEM_MAKE_TYPE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'ITEM_MAKE_TYPE' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON}) ,
TAX_TYPE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'TAX_TYPE' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON}) ,
SELLER_ITEM_NO = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'SELLER_ITEM_NO' , #{CHG_VALUE}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{CHG_REASON}) ,
CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS')
WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1))
AND (BUY_PRICE IS NULL OR TO_NUMBER(#{CHG_VALUE}) <= BUY_PRICE)
mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoDetailMapList*/ SELECT (SELECT G.COMORG_CODE FROM BYCAORGL G WHERE G.COMORG_CODE = (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER)) AS GROUP_CODE , (SELECT G.COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL G WHERE G.COMORG_CODE = (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER)) AS GROUP_NAME , Q.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , Q.BUYER_ITEM_NO , Q.CONTRACT_NO , Q.CONTRACT_SEQ , NVL(Q.CSV_YN, 'N') AS CSV_YN , (SELECT DECODE(R.CONTRACT_FLAG, 'F', 'Y', 'N') FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE R WHERE R.BUYER = Q.BUYER AND R.TO_DATE = '299912') AS FEE_BASE_YN , (SELECT RTRIM(TO_CHAR(R.RATE, 'FM999,990.99'), '.') FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE R WHERE R.BUYER = Q.BUYER AND R.TO_DATE = '299912') AS FEE_BASE_RATE , Q.BUYER || '|' || Q.CONTRACT_NO || '|' || Q.CONTRACT_SEQ AS TCODE FROM ICOMCQDT Q WHERE Q.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND Q.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1)) ORDER BY Q.BUYER, Q.CONTRACT_NO, Q.CONTRACT_SEQ
